name: HTML Templates and Themes Library (html.design)
demand: The category has observable use, but a marketwide demand total is unverified. HTML5 UP publishes per-template download counters, including 773,804 for Massively, while ThemeForest lists over 24,900 HTML templates; these show established usage and supply, not the addressable market for this asset (https://html5up.net/, https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates). Third-party keyword estimates report 1,000 monthly searches for “simple html website template” and 1,900 for “simple website template”; another database reports 2,000 monthly searches for “html templates” in Germany, updated 2026-09-26. Treat these as directional because the query scope and methods are not independently validated (https://trenzhub.com/t/simple_html_website_template, https://www.performance-suite.io/keyword-db/de-de/html-templates/). The current site’s media kit claims 100,000 monthly visitors, 240,000 monthly ad impressions, and 68% developers, described as GA4-verified; the raw analytics were not available to inspect (https://html.design/advertising/).
prices: The live site sells a one-time $5 licence to remove attribution (https://html.design/license/). HTML5 UP templates are free, with attribution-free use via Pixelarity advertised for $19 (https://html5up.net/). ThemeForest displays HTML templates from $5 to $49 among examples on its current category page (https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates). Templateo advertises $25/month or $99/year for its editor and template features (https://templateo.com/pricing). These free and low-cost substitutes limit pricing power.

revenue_proof.claim: The seller states $7,965 TTM revenue and $7,545 TTM profit; the listing’s summary labels $7,965 ARR. It also states average monthly revenue of $621 and hosting costs of about $35/month. These are seller claims, not verified payout or accounting evidence; the underlying monthly statements were not supplied. The listing says revenue includes ads, sponsorships, licence sales, and occasional custom design or lead-generation work.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: 2026-09-10 listing publication; exact TTM period and underlying payment dates are undisclosed.

revenue_proof.claim: The listing says 1,980 customers in its headline metrics but 1,975 registered accounts in the description. Neither figure proves paid customers, and no cohort, repeat-purchase, or retention records are published.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: 2026-09-10 listing publication; underlying count date is undisclosed.

revenue_proof.claim: The seller says revenue is lower than two years earlier but gives no comparison-period figures or decline percentage. This self-described deterioration has zero weight as quantified revenue evidence.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: Statement published 2026-09-10 about an approximate 2024 comparison; exact dates and figures are undisclosed.

copy_speed: Recent direct and adjacent moves show fast imitation and catalog churn: ThemeVault made its 190 HTML templates free on 2026-09-15 and offers a $49/year or $129 lifetime no-credit plan (https://www.themevault.net/every-themevault-template-is-now-free); uiCookies moved TemplateMag’s free Bootstrap catalog into its own catalog on 2026-07-16 (https://uicookies.com/templatemag-joins-uicookies/); DreamHost opened Remixer templates to all customers on 2026-09-24 with conversational and visual editing (https://www.news.dream.press/news/announcements/pick-a-template-then-tell-remixer-what-to-change/). I found no publicly dated post-April launch of an exact 848-template plus AI-editor clone. The public CC BY licence allows sharing and adaptation with attribution, so template pages are easier to copy than the domain, ranking history, and backlinks; no quantified copy time is available (https://html.design/license/).
platform_risk: High concentration risk: the seller says traffic is effectively 100% organic search and that it has never bought ads, so ranking or search-policy changes could materially affect visits (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website). The seller lists AdSense revenue; Google’s AdSense help says account ownership transfers are not permitted, creating a potential interruption while a buyer establishes monetization under its own account (https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/2628816?hl=en). The listing says payments run through Dodo Payments, but no Dodo account transfer approval or replacement setup is evidenced; Cloudways, Cloudflare, domain, and analytics access transfer are also unverified (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website).
defensible_asset: The claimed 848-template catalog, 75 articles, domain history, backlinks, and organic rankings could be a useful compiled SEO asset, but those counts and rankings are seller-stated and the backlink quality is unverified (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website). The current site says its 800+ templates are under CC BY 3.0, permitting commercial use, adaptation, and redistribution with attribution; its submission page says submitters agree to that licence. This makes the catalog non-exclusive for users and leaves the seller’s right to sell attribution removal across every template needing a rights-chain check (https://html.design/license/, https://html.design/submit/).
build_effort: This is an existing bespoke Laravel 10/PHP 8.3/MySQL product with an editor, database, and payment integration, so it avoids a greenfield build; however, the seller says no staff or contractors are included and describes sponsorship inquiries, new templates, and custom work as ongoing tasks (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website). The current site also advertises manual PSD/Figma conversion, WordPress conversion, and website maintenance services (https://html.design/). Inference: transition and upkeep require a code-capable operator, and the labor mix is not established well enough to conclude this fits a mostly agent-run solo operation.
channel: Use organic category and template SEO, the on-site download/editor funnel, opt-in subscriptions, and inbound sponsorship placements; the seller describes SEO as its sole acquisition channel and the current site offers template submissions and advertising placements (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website, https://html.design/submit/, https://html.design/advertising/). No cold outreach is needed. Do not re-upload the library unmodified to commercial template marketplaces: the published licence expressly disallows that (https://html.design/license/).
owner_hours_per_week: Unverified; the seller describes workload as low but supplies no time log or evidence for <=5 hours/week. The listing also mentions sponsor requests, new templates, and occasional custom work, while the live site advertises additional hands-on services (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website, https://html.design/).
automation_reason: The seller provides no task-level hours or automation records. Hosting, download delivery, checkout, monitoring, and support triage may be automatable, but sponsorship handling, template curation, and advertised custom conversion and maintenance work can require human labor. A defensible share of all work cannot be estimated from the available evidence (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website, https://html.design/).
listing_check: Not currently acquirable: Microns marks the listing Already Sold (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website). Revenue and profit are seller-stated and unverified; subscription churn is described as not applicable, but user retention and repeat purchases are undisclosed. Owner hours are unverified. The historical $18,500 asking price divided by stated $7,545 TTM profit is 2.45x, calculated from unverified listing figures. The listing names the domain, code, database, catalog, accounts, ad relationships, and sponsorship relationships as assets, but no transfer evidence is public. AdSense ownership cannot be transferred under Google’s published terms; Dodo transferability is unverified (https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/2628816?hl=en, https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website).
moat_assessment: It passed the initial compiled-asset kill check, but the moat is conditional and weaker than the seller’s description suggests. The catalog and search footprint may take time to reproduce, yet the site’s published CC BY terms permit third parties to reuse and adapt the templates with attribution; no network effect or meaningful customer switching cost is evidenced. Verify rights for the full catalog, the attribution-removal licence, Google Search Console history, and backlink quality before assigning moat value (https://html.design/license/, https://html.design/submit/, https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website).
desk_test: First fail the availability check: the listing is marked Already Sold. If it is relisted, run a one-working-day, $0 document gate using seller-provided exports: reconcile 12 months of revenue by stream to ad-network, sponsor, payment-processor, and bank records; inspect 24 months of monthly Search Console and analytics data; request owner task/time logs; and verify template ownership or contributor permissions, domain/code/hosting handover, and payment-provider transfer requirements. Stop if records, rights, or transfer steps are missing. The listing currently supplies none of those records (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website, https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/2628816?hl=en).
red_flags: Already sold; all financial, traffic, download, and workload figures in the sale listing are unverified. The listing says 1,980 customers but 1,975 registered accounts, and revenue includes some custom work. The live About page says the site was established in 2014 and describes an original team plus four, while the sale listing says launched in 2017 and operated by one person; these may reflect post-sale edits, but the timeline and operating model are unreconciled (https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/html-templates-and-themes-website, https://html.design/about/). The current About page claims 68,000 newsletter subscribers while its advertising media kit says 15,000, another unreconciled audience claim (https://html.design/about/, https://html.design/advertising/). Public CC BY terms and community submissions make catalog ownership and the paid attribution-removal offer material diligence issues (https://html.design/license/, https://html.design/submit/).
